name: Ubud
blurb: Ubud remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
The food alone would be worth the trip.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
